status: read-only design; defer implementation until a coherent inference dependency upgrade
decision: Do not ship an all-unknown consumer stub or label group dispatch versions as exact sampled-token provenance. Prefer the independent metric-accumulation unit next, subject to its numerical review.

excluded_behavior: cde40c64 stale-token masking replaces group cancellation

already_present: GroupState.policy_version_at_start and InflightRollout.policy_version are scheduler provenance; dispatcher copies the group start version to each Rollout and cache salt.
InflightRollout.off_policy_steps counts weight updates while a rollout is in flight; existing thresholds cancel groups. Preserve this behavior and its existing metrics.
ValueTrajectory owns a copied policy_version together with immutable token/mask/layout/private-prefix credit inputs. ValueRollout retains both policy_version and critic value_version.

Value replay batches aggregate policy_version_min/max and value_version_min/max; the value trainer already logs source versions, spreads, and critic lag. These are distinct from token-level engine provenance.
The policy trainer already measures aggregate/per-environment mismatch KL and saturation diagnostics. Staleness bins and exact per-token versions are absent.
missing_producer_chain: Pinned vLLM0.24.0 has no adopted0.32 update_weight_version/span contract. Current inference/vllm/server.py loads weights via collective_rpc but never labels the engine version.

Current utils/client.py already accepts step for weight updates, but sends only weight_dir to /update_weights and no version on LoRA loads. Pass the version through existing transport paths; a transport directory reorganization is unnecessary.
Renderer bdb96b0c does not return weight_versions from a generate choice. Its required pass-through is upstream0526944.

Verifier b13ba60d has no WeightVersionSpan, TurnTokens.weight_versions or MessageNode.weight_versions. Upstream3f142cc61 supplies these fields and transfers them during graph commit; it is414 commits beyond the current pin, with renderer>=0.1.12 and Harbor0.24 metadata at that revision. A blind pin advance would greatly exceed this feature.

Current Episode-to-Rollout adapter preserves canonical trace fields, but cannot preserve a field absent from the pinned canonical schema. Use actual upstream schema when upgrading; do not add a parallel faux trace format.
future_atomic_scope: First validate a coherent vLLM/renderer/verifier stack upgrade independently, including serving-token wrapper compatibility, native and legacy environment bridges, tokenizer/prompt parity and actor/critic numerical behavior. Do not change FP32 optimization/reduction settings.

Label the engine only after successful full-weight or LoRA adoption. Label boot/resume versions before dispatch. Verify the existing filesystem/NCCL paths rather than assuming upstream renamed transports are prerequisites.

Carry completion-indexed spans through renderer, TurnTokens, canonical graph commit, actual WireEpisode serialization and the single-trace adapter. Preserve exact sampling mask alignment across multi-turn and shared-prefix branches.

Append optional observation-only fields to current transport/types.py structs; propagate them through trainer/batch.py truncation, packing, padding and trainer/rl/data.py CP splitting. Do not import upstream transport reorganization or padding semantics.

Stamp age against the version of weights used for that training batch, not the current engine version at logging time. Use -1 for unknown/non-sampled/padding. Report known/unknown coverage explicitly; do not reuse upstream policy.start fallback under an exact-token-age metric name.

Fold mismatch diagnostics into bins using the reviewed metric accumulator. Preserve all policy/value loss inputs, masks, denominators, sample selection, group cancellation, private critic context and value replay semantics. Keep critic source policy_version as its original group provenance; add separate fields only if later required.

Document limitations: bin0 can still contain numerical/backend/cache effects and is not proof of correctness. An unlabeled backend or legacy bridge must remain visibly unknown rather than be treated as fresh.
independent_acceptance_gates: One actual paused-generation weight update: observe old/new spans in a single response, then a fully new-version response; also verify boot/resume labeling and failed adoption never reports a falsely advanced version. Run through the real renderer and canonical Episode wire, not a fabricated endpoint response alone.

One compact alignment oracle through real graph/branch materialization and packing: multi-turn assistant scaffolds, shared branch prefixes, reused context, missing/default labels, partial spans, truncation/padding and CP slices. Independent expected token positions, coverage and bins; no branch-index guesses or treating context as sampled.

Reject or explicitly mark unknown malformed overlap/out-of-range/future labels. Test ages at32767/32768 and the64+ boundary so int16 cannot silently wrap. Diagnostic invalidity must not silently alter objective/admission masks.

Actual codec roundtrip with old messages missing the optional trailing field and new messages carrying it. Verify append-only compatibility empirically with the installed msgspec configuration, including the actual transport codec.

Paired frozen/current policy and value update on identical batches: full gradients, optimizer states, protected value trajectory/private prompts and cancellation emissions unchanged. A small hand-computed distributed bin case checks global count-weighted mean/std/max and coverage, including an empty rank; avoid averaging rank means.

Do not claim support for LoRA, alternate weight transports or legacy bridges based solely on the full-weight native test; either exercise each supported changed producer or retain a clearly unknown provenance path.
audit_limits: Read local source and exact Git diffs; no production edits, dependency changes, or GPU experiments performed for this design.
A broad renderer history query hit a missing promisor Git object. Exact relevant0526944 diff was readable; no history repair or completeness claim was made.

No claim that every vLLM0.24 internal symbol was searched remotely; required0.32 contract is established by the exact upstream feature and renderer commits, and the current producer chain definitively does not use it.
